signals.title: USD/JPY — Yield Spread Expansion vs Options Downside Skew
signals.text: USD/JPY closed Friday at 157.28, supported by an expanding US-Japan 10Y sovereign yield gap of 209bp and a +289bp OIS carry advantage in favor of USD. However, JPY COT LF positioning surged by +73.3k contracts to net +20.1k (95th percentile, z=+1.57), while 1M 25-delta risk reversals reflect heavy downside protection demand at -2.28 put skew. The BoJ meeting on 30 Oct is the catalyst that decides if Japanese monetary tightening can overcome the Fed's 4.00% terminal rate anchor. Trade bias: Bullish USD/JPY on carry resilience, though options demand warns of abrupt pullbacks. Catalyst: BoJ meeting on 30 Oct. Risk: Coordinated verbal or physical currency intervention pushes spot below the 20-day SMA at 156.54.
evidence: JPY COT LF net: +20,069 (95th percentile, z=+1.57)

signals.title: EUR/USD — Bearish Real Rate Divergence & Technical Breakdown
signals.text: EUR COT LF net short stands at -51.4k contracts (38.4% long) as EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1395, trapped below all major moving averages (SMA20 at 1.1548, SMA200 at 1.1626). The Fed-ECB policy stance favors the dollar via a +137bp real policy rate spread (+1.68% US vs +0.31% Eurozone) and a +143bp OIS carry advantage for USD. The ECB meeting on 29 Oct is the catalyst that tests whether Governing Council inflation warnings can halt the persistent 2Y sovereign yield spread compression (-158bp vs US). Trade bias: Bearish EUR/USD targeting deeper retracement below 1.1350. Catalyst: ECB meeting on 29 Oct. Risk: Preliminary Eurozone CPI prints well above expectations, forcing front-end yields to reprice ECB hike odds.
evidence: EUR/USD technicals: below SMA20 (1.1548) and SMA200 (1.1626)

signals.title: USD/CHF — Negative Real Carry Compression vs Depressed Volatility
signals.text: CHF COT LF net short rests at -16.7k (7th percentile, z=-1.36), reflecting substantial institutional short exposure as USD/CHF closed Friday at 0.8284. A 400bp nominal central bank policy gap and negative Swiss real rates (-1.24% vs +1.68% US) maintain steady structural upward drift above the 200-day SMA at 0.7945, while 1M implied volatility trades below 30-day realized volatility at 6.2% vs 7.4% (VRP -1.1%). The SNB meeting on 10 Dec is the catalyst that determines whether negative interest rates remain entrenched or policy normalization begins. Trade bias: Bullish USD/CHF riding wide carry differentials. Catalyst: SNB meeting on 10 Dec. Risk: Escalating Middle East shipping conflict triggers safe-haven flows into the Swiss Franc, breaking spot below the 20-day SMA at 0.8158.
evidence: CHF COT LF net: -16,664 (7th percentile, z=-1.36)
